name: QR Code Generator
description: Generate QR codes from text, Wi-Fi networks or contact cards, with custom colors, module shapes and a centered logo. Decode QR images locally (paste/drop/upload), export PNG or SVG, copy to clipboard, keep a history and named style presets.
releaseNotes: Two-pane generator layout with unified capacity counters and contextual empty/error recovery; named style presets; SVG vector export; semantic file names; batch mode with combined sheet export; Wi-Fi share card; scan-verification badge; local image-decode tab (paste/drop/upload); accessibility pass.

zh-CN.name: 二维码工具
zh-CN.description: 文本、Wi-Fi、名片一键生成二维码：自定义颜色、码点形状与中心 Logo，本地解码识别二维码图片（粘贴/拖拽/上传），导出 PNG/SVG、复制到剪贴板，支持历史记录与样式预设。
